description: Statistics for one recent Bitcoin block (this pruned node keeps roughly the last 10,000) by height or hash: tx count, total fees, fee-rate percentiles, size, weight, subsidy, inputs and outputs, SegWit share, and the miner (coinbase tag and pool). Paid per call. Price: 3 sats or US$0.003 (USDC) per call.

block_id.description: Block height (for example 974000) or block hash (64 hex characters)

l402.description: Optional. After paying the Lightning invoice: '<token>:<preimage>'.

pay_with.description: Optional. 'lightning' returns a BOLT11 invoice and a token instead of the x402 payment request.

name: bitcoin_block_stats
title: Bitcoin block statistics and miner
